title: Support `Sentry.SourceGenerators` via Visual Studio 2019 version 16.11
reason: The failure is in the .NET SDK's Sentry.SourceGenerators analyzer compatibility with Visual Studio 2019/Roslyn. It occurs during the consumer's build, before events reach Sentry, so the SDK repository is the appropriate owner.
notes: Build-time .NET SDK analyzer failure. Only sentry-dotnet example in the routing dataset, so holding it out leaves zero dotnet examples.

title: Snuba seems to set timestamp_ms to a max value
reason: The failure is in Sentry's event viewing path: malformed/extreme event timestamps cause the UI to return HTTP 500. Although reproduced in self-hosted deployment with ClickHouse/Snuba, the reported user-facing malfunction is in the core Issues event display rather than an SDK-specific repository.
notes: Self-hosted Snuba/ClickHouse timestamp error. Reporter-selected Product Area was Issues.

title: sentry import global silently drops all but one ProjectKey per project
reason: This is a defect in Sentry's core global export/import relocation implementation (`ProjectKey.write_relocation_import`), not an installation or deployment problem. The detailed reproduction and identified faulty lookup support keeping it in the main repository.
notes: Self-hosted user, but the root cause cited is in src/sentry (ProjectKey relocation import). A STAY prediction is defensible; a mismatch here is not necessarily an agent error.

title: 404 when adding a new GH repository
reason: The failure occurs specifically in a self-hosted installation while configuring a GitHub repository. Repository-level deployment/configuration issues are handled in getsentry/self-hosted, and a closely matching confirmed transfer exists for a self-hosted repository-integration failure.
notes: Self-hosted GitHub integration 404 with almost no detail (screenshot only). Reporter-selected Product Area was Settings - Repositories.

title: Taskworker KAFKA_TOPIC_OVERRIDES Ignored
reason: The report identifies a server-side Sentry taskbroker/Kafka topic-resolution defect in core Sentry code. Although reproduced with the Helm chart, the suspected faulty producer path is in getsentry/sentry and the failure prevents ingestion processing.
notes: Helm-chart deployment, but the analysis points to taskworker code in src/sentry. Ambiguous ownership.
